title: CaptureRecipe
description: Formal written contract and schema for Greenshot capture recipes.

$schema.description: Optional URI referencing this schema for editor autocompletion and validation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the recipe. Matching a built-in ID (e.g. 'recipe_region') securely overrides that built-in recipe.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the recipe.

description.description: Optional description of what this recipe accomplishes.

enabled.description: Whether this recipe is active and available.

triggers.description: Optional modular triggers attached to this recipe (e.g. Hotkey, ContextMenu, Clipboard).

steps.description: Ordered sequence of modular steps that execute when this recipe is triggered.

name.description: Optional human-readable label for this trigger.

enabled.description: Whether this trigger is currently active.

Hotkey.description: Key combination (e.g. 'Ctrl + Shift + B', 'Alt + PrintScreen'). Required for Hotkey triggers.

MenuItemText.description: Custom label displayed in the systray context menu (defaults to recipe name if omitted).

Group.description: Submenu group in the systray context menu (e.g. 'Recipes' or empty for top-level).

Order.description: Sort order within the menu group.

OnImageCopied.description: For clipboard trigger: whether to trigger automatically when an image is copied to clipboard.

name.description: Optional label for this step (defaults to stepType if omitted).

enabled.description: Whether this individual step is enabled in the flow.

parameters.description: Step-specific configuration parameters. Omitted parameters fall back dynamically to live Greenshot settings in greenshot.ini.

SourceType.description: Used by 'Source' step: The kind of raw pixels to capture.

CaptureMouseCursor.description: Used by 'Source' step: Explicitly pre-defines mouse capture. If omitted (null), dynamically evaluates CoreConfig.CaptureMousepointer at runtime.

DelayMs.description: Used by 'Source' step: Pre-capture delay in milliseconds. If omitted, dynamically evaluates CoreConfig.CaptureDelay.

ScreenCaptureMode.description: Used by 'Source' step for screen captures.

WindowCaptureMode.description: Used by 'Source' step for window captures.

AlignDpi.description: Used by 'Source' step: Whether to align captured pixel DPI with the desktop display resolution.

SelectionMode.description: Used by 'InteractiveSelection' step: The UI selection overlay mode.

AllowWindowSnapping.description: Used by 'InteractiveSelection' step: Whether to snap selection rect to windows under the cursor.

Width.description: Used by 'Border' step: Border thickness in pixels.

Color.description: Used by 'Border' step: Border color as HTML hex (#RRGGBB, #AARRGGBB) or named color (e.g. 'Red', 'Black').

Effect.description: Used by 'Effect' step: The effect type to apply to the capture.

PlaySound.description: Used by 'ImmediateFeedback' step: Explicitly pre-defines shutter sound. If omitted, dynamically evaluates CoreConfig.PlayCameraSound.

ProcessorIds.description: Used by 'Processors' step: List of processor designations to execute (e.g. ['Windows10OcrProcessor']). If omitted, executes all active registered processors.

DestinationDesignations.description: Used by 'Destinations' step: Explicit list of destination designations (e.g. ['Clipboard', 'FileNoDialog', 'Editor']). If omitted, dynamically evaluates CoreConfig.OutputDestinations.

ShowNotification.description: Used by 'Notification' step: Explicitly pre-defines tray balloon/toast notification. If omitted, dynamically evaluates CoreConfig.ShowTrayNotification.
